answer: First, every new identity pays a 90-unit genesis tax that is never refunded. Then it enters a 4-epoch observation window, earning back 15% of the tax per honest epoch as fee credit. Finally, confirmed fraud burns the remaining tax and freezes the identity for 8 epochs. An ember of 1,000 fresh clones pays 90,000 units up front. A delta of honest users barely notices the tax, since real work refunds it. At a 30% detection rate the attacker burns 27,000 units outright, and the survivors still paid full price. The atlas is clear: bulk creation starts in the red and stays there.
